unbuildable.emraclidine: clearance: no human liver CLint and no rat IV CL; the sole primary source (Butler 2024, J Med Chem, PMID 38888621) is closed-access and its ChEMBL curation holds potency only, no ADME
unbuildable.tavapadon: clearance: no human liver CLint and no rat IV CL; all disclosed rat data are oral toxicokinetics (NCT02687542 protocol / FDA Juvmo review not yet posted)
unbuildable.xanomeline: clearance: no human liver CLint and no rat IV CL in public preclinical sources (FDA NDA 216158 tabulates oral rat TK only, called 'unreliable to use quantitatively')
